\noindent This glossary is canonical for the first design/protocol manuscript. Units are explicit because tuples and typed records are not silently added as numerical vectors.

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.35em,itemsep=0.52em]
  \item ${i}$ --- Individual identifier; never a fixed person feature vector. \textit{Unit or type: index.}
  \item ${t}$ --- Decision point within or between sessions. \textit{Unit or type: decision index.}
  \item ${n}$ --- Journey stage or adjacent generated-audio segment. \textit{Unit or type: stage index.}
  \item ${z_{i,t}}$ --- Consent-bounded moment information available to the system. \textit{Unit or type: heterogeneous record.}
  \item ${o^{\mathrm{usr}}_{i,t}}$ --- Explicit person-authored check-in and correction observations. \textit{Unit or type: observation record.}
  \item ${o^{\mathrm{opt}}_{i,t}}$ --- Optional separately consented measurements or derived observations. \textit{Unit or type: observation record.}
  \item ${g_{i,t}}$ --- Desired direction or time-indexed journey proposal, not a guaranteed state. \textit{Unit or type: journey representation.}
  \item ${\mathcal{H}_{i,<t}}$ --- Prior evidence eligible under current retention, consent, and relevance review. \textit{Unit or type: record set.}
  \item ${S^{\mathrm{ctx}}_{i,t}}$ --- Context state separating source events, projections, and provenance. \textit{Unit or type: record tuple.}
  \item ${L_{i,t}}$ --- Consented lossless source-event record. \textit{Unit or type: event set.}
  \item ${P_{i,t}}$ --- Replaceable derived context views. \textit{Unit or type: projection set.}
  \item ${V_{i,t}}$ --- Lineage and version information for context derivations. \textit{Unit or type: version and provenance set.}
  \item ${A_{i,t}}$ --- Active source-, purpose-, action-, time-, and retention-scoped consent grant. \textit{Unit or type: authority set.}
  \item ${c^{\mathrm{work}}_{i,t}}$ --- Reviewed working context permitted for the current purpose. \textit{Unit or type: semantic record.}
  \item ${\pi}$ --- Consent-constrained derivation from retained context to a working view. \textit{Unit or type: projection operator.}
  \item ${m_j}$ --- Versioned semantic mixin with purpose, bounds, neutral position, and exclusions. \textit{Unit or type: typed control.}
  \item ${k^{\mathrm{usr}}_{j,t}, k^{\mathrm{acc}}_{j,t}, k^0_j}$ --- Current user value, explicitly accepted suggestion, and neutral default. \textit{Unit or type: dimensionless in [0,1].}
  \item ${\alpha_{j,t}}$ --- Smoothed effective mixin authority for an ordinary non-safety control. \textit{Unit or type: dimensionless in [0,1].}
  \item ${\rho_j}$ --- Visible mixin-specific smoothing rate. \textit{Unit or type: dimensionless in (0,1].}
  \item ${q_{i,n}}$ --- Resolved, model-independent semantic condition for stage n. \textit{Unit or type: typed semantic condition.}
  \item ${\oplus}$ --- Versioned semantic composition; not numerical addition or text concatenation. \textit{Unit or type: typed composition operator.}
  \item ${\Xi_{i,t}}$ --- Active exclusions, safety constraints, and prohibited transitions. \textit{Unit or type: constraint set.}
  \item ${\prec_{i,t}}$ --- Visible conflict-resolution and authority order. \textit{Unit or type: precedence relation.}
  \item ${J_{i,t}}$ --- Accepted model-independent stages, semantic intent, and acoustic controls. \textit{Unit or type: journey-plan record.}
  \item ${\mathcal{K}_a}$ --- Controls and limits declared by model adapter a. \textit{Unit or type: capability set.}
  \item ${\gamma^{(a)}_{i,n}}$ --- Adapter-bounded conditioning state with uncertainty, conflicts, and provenance. \textit{Unit or type: conditioning record.}
  \item ${\varphi^{(a)}_{i,n}}$ --- Optional prompt projection of the conditioning state; not canonical intent. \textit{Unit or type: adapter-native text or tokens.}
  \item ${b_{i,t}(x)}$ --- Uncertain system belief assigned to candidate represented state x. \textit{Unit or type: probability.}
  \item ${U, u_{i,t}}$ --- Candidate horizon and one semantic or musical control proposal. \textit{Unit or type: control sequence and control record.}
  \item ${H_p}$ --- Finite planning horizon. \textit{Unit or type: decision steps.}
  \item ${\bar{L}_g,\bar{D}_{\Delta},\bar{R},\bar{C}_{\mathrm{burden}}}$ --- Journey mismatch, control change, risk or uncertainty, and interaction burden terms. \textit{Unit or type: normalized dimensionless costs.}
  \item ${B_{i,t}}$ --- Duration of verified playable audio already buffered. \textit{Unit or type: seconds.}
  \item ${\ell_{\mathrm{observe}},\ell_{\mathrm{plan}},\ell_{\mathrm{generate}},\ell_{\mathrm{verify}},\ell_{\mathrm{schedule}}}$ --- Measured component latencies along the generate-ahead path. \textit{Unit or type: seconds.}
  \item ${M_{i,t}}$ --- Hardware- and adapter-specific latency uncertainty margin. \textit{Unit or type: seconds.}
  \item ${D^{\mathrm{sem}}_n,D^{\mathrm{ac}}_n}$ --- Semantic-plan and measured acoustic-boundary distances. \textit{Unit or type: dimensionless.}
  \item ${\mathcal{F},f_r,d_r,w_r}$ --- Versioned components of the acoustic-boundary comparison. \textit{Unit or type: feature set, extractor, normalized distance, and dimensionless weight.}
  \item ${a_n(s),y(s)}$ --- Adjacent input signals and renderer output over an overlap window. \textit{Unit or type: sample amplitude.}
  \item ${e_{i,t}}$ --- What content was actually played, for how long, and with what interruption state. \textit{Unit or type: exposure record.}
  \item ${\mathsf{Y}_{i,t}}$ --- Separated perceived, felt, evaluative, harm, mismatch, and aftereffect observations. \textit{Unit or type: heterogeneous response record.}
  \item ${\theta_i}$ --- Versioned person-specific response-model hypothesis, if a later protocol fits one. \textit{Unit or type: model parameter set.}
  \item ${\mathcal{D}_{i,1:t}}$ --- Qualifying provenance-linked observations through decision point t. \textit{Unit or type: evidence set.}
\end{itemize}
